fal-local-drn.name: FALdetector local detector (DRN-C-26 flow), FP32 ONNX
fal-local-drn.license: Apache-2.0 (repository LICENSE at the pinned revision; weights distributed by the authors with the repository)
fal-local-drn.export: torch.onnx.export opset 17, dynamic H/W, inputs 'image' [1,3,H,W] ImageNet-normalized, output 'flow' [1,2,H,W]; max |torch - onnx| 6e-6 on the upstream examples
fal-local-drn.note: Trained only on Photoshop Face-Aware Liquify warps of face crops. Not an AI-generation detector.
